thesis: The episode explores how commodities differ fundamentally from other asset classes like rates due to their unique drivers of term structure, which include inventory, supply, demand, and geopolitics rather than central bank policies. The conversation also introduces the concept of cash and carry economics as a tether between spot and futures prices, noting that this mechanism can snap under specific conditions.
